name: memory-keeping-system
description:
Creates organized systems for preserving family memories including photo management, journaling traditions, keepsake curation, and digital archiving strategies. Produces structured memory-keeping plans with storage systems, curation workflows, and preservation schedules.
Use when the user asks about organizing family photos, preserving memories, creating memory books, or setting up a keepsake management system.
Do NOT use for professional photography techniques (use design-creative skills) or social media content creation.
